name: web-illustration-browser-window-musicians-flat-scene
title: Flat illustration of musicians framed inside a browser window
whatItIs: A flat vector illustration of two people playing music at a small table, staged inside a browser-window frame with decorative clouds, lanterns, target and flag icons floating around the outside.
whatItMeans: Embedding an illustrated scene inside a browser-chrome frame signals 'this is what the website/product looks like' even though the content is purely illustrative, bridging marketing art and product screenshot.
techniques: contain an illustrated scene within a literal browser-window frame to imply 'this is the site'
surround the framed scene with smaller decorative icon props to fill negative space
use warm terracotta and purple tones to give a flat illustration a cozy, inviting feel
bestFor: hobby or event website hero illustrations

vocabulary.definition: using a browser window's visual chrome as a container to signal web/digital context
